reasoning: This is a diagnostic/support data-collection tool (must-gather). It builds a container image that, when run via 'oc adm must-gather' or as a Kubernetes Job, executes shell scripts to collect logs, resource definitions, and cluster state from Red Hat OpenShift AI namespaces and CRDs. It is not an operator, library, service, or configuration repository — it is a troubleshooting utility that gathers diagnostic information for support cases.
